description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PayGradeService, focusing on testing the service's methods related to pay grade management, currency associations, and related data retrieval within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin.

classes.name: PayGradeServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the functionality of PayGradeService methods, including retrieval, creation, and deletion of pay grades and related entities, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of PayGradeService, and populates fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeDao
methods.description: Verifies that the PayGradeService correctly returns an instance of PayGradeDao.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of pay grades from the service.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific pay grade by its ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Verifies fetching the list of currencies associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific currency for a specific pay grade based on currency ID.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Checks the conversion of PayPeriod entities to an array format.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeArray
methods.description: Verifies the conversion of PayGrade entities to an array format.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyArray
methods.description: Verifies the conversion of CurrencyType entities into an array with id and label.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Tests the count retrieval for pay grade currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of pay grade currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Tests saving a new PayGrade entity.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Tests deletion of pay grade(s) by ID.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Tests obtaining the count of allowed pay currencies.
